description: This file defines function prototypes and constants related to WiFi Event handling in a security or network management project. It includes function declarations for setting event handlers and refreshing WiFi access points and endpoints, indicating its role in managing WiFi-related events within the project.

methods.name: wifiGen_setRadEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets handlers for radio events, taking a pointer to T_Radio.

methods.name: wifiGen_setVapEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets handlers for VAP (Virtual Access Point) events, taking a pointer to T_AccessPoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_setEpEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets handlers for endpoint events, taking a pointer to T_EndPoint.

methods.name: wifiGen_refreshVapsIfIdx
methods.description: Refreshes VAPs based on the provided radio pointer.

methods.name: wifiGen_refreshEpConnChspec
methods.description: Refreshes endpoint connection channel spectrum, taking T_EndPoint pointer.

methods.name: wifiGen_refreshEpConnStatus
methods.description: Refreshes endpoint connection status, taking T_EndPoint pointer.
